svg.title: Contractor portal: Jobs and Invoices in the top nav
svg.text: Contractor portal: Jobs and Invoices in the top nav
Each option at laptop (Jobs picked), tablet (Invoices picked) and phone (Jobs picked). The gold underline marks the page you're on.
A. Tabs in the top bar
Jobs and Invoices sit beside the wordmark in today's bar. One bar, no extra height.
Phones drop the words "HG Capital Partners" to make room, as the app's own bar does. Needs a TopTabs variant with no divider of its own.

g.text: Due date Mon, Nov 30 · QA Test Oct27 Portfolio 1 Apt 4b
Mon, Nov 30 · QA Test Oct27 Portfolio 1 Apt 4b

svg.text: B. A tab row under the bar (recommended)
Today's bar, then the stock TopTabs row in the same chrome; the row's divider is the header's edge. GitHub's and Vercel's headers work this way.
The same at every width, the wordmark stays on phones. Costs one row: 38px on a laptop, 44px on touch.

g.text: Due date Mon, Nov 30 · QA Test Oct27 Portfolio 1 Apt 4b
Mon, Nov 30 · QA Test Oct27 Portfolio 1 Apt 4b

svg.text: C. A bottom bar on phones and tablets
Jobs and Invoices in a bar fixed to the bottom, as the Jobber, Angi and Upwork apps do; the laptop gets A's tabs in the top bar.
Material keeps a bottom bar for 3 to 5 places, and shadcn has no tab bar, so this one would be built from scratch.

g.text: Due date Mon, Nov 30 · QA Test Oct27 Portfolio 1 Apt 4b
Mon, Nov 30 · QA Test Oct27 Portfolio 1 Apt 4b

svg.text: The tabs show on My jobs and Your invoices. A job page keeps its back arrow and has no tabs.
Your invoices trades its back-arrow bar for the tabbed one, so both pages share one header.
Your invoices leaves the account menu, since the tab carries it (drawn on the right).
Page bodies stay as built, headings included: the address line's "Or email them to" reads off the "Your invoices" title.
One weight for both tabs. The page you're on gets the gold underline and aria-current="page", as Financials and Settings do.
A crew link only ever opens its one job, so it never sees the tabs. Fits one line at 320.
